desc: DONE through the ticket-100 B0 release-object proof. The exact OpenRC root independently verified tty0 inittab/service ordering with no ttydc0 dependency; live boot reached the Alpine local shell on the internal simpledrm/fbcon panel and the maintainer typed a line that echoed through the internal keyboard. Watchdog, default runlevel, input0/event0, and empty partitions also passed. No new MMIO. This satisfies U5's on-device-console function; a conventional password-authenticated getty may be a later distro-hardening choice, not a missing hardware experiment.
